principles.title: Use Ubiquitous Language
principles.summary: Make product concepts easy to identify through consistent names in customer conversations, interfaces, and code.

principles.title: Validate at Use
principles.summary: Check the current facts at the action that depends on them.

principles.title: Use Simplified Technical English
principles.summary: Use ASD-STE100 structural rules to make technical text clear, consistent, and easy to translate.

principles.title: Avoid Sunk Cost Fallacy
principles.summary: Keep future changes aligned with current requirements.

principles.title: Cite the rule, do not copy it
principles.summary: Keep comments accurate by linking them to one versioned rule instead of repeating that rule across the codebase.

principles.title: Make accepted risks explicit
principles.summary: Show that a known risk is a deliberate trade, and state when the team must review it again.

principles.title: Canonical by construction
principles.summary: Store exact identifiers so every part of the system agrees on what each reference means.

principles.title: Separate operational state from history
principles.summary: Give current status and clocks an explicit owner instead of inferring them from an audit log.

principles.title: Borrow infrastructure and own domain behavior
principles.summary: Use maintained packages for established technical problems and keep product decisions in your code.

principles.title: Tests earn their cost
principles.summary: Test a concrete failure at the least costly layer that gives sufficient new confidence.

principles.title: Keep domain decisions in one place
principles.summary: Keep product decisions consistent by giving each domain rule one owner.

principles.title: Refuse before the work exists
principles.summary: Check predictable limits at the earliest informed boundary and preserve work after a later refusal.

principles.title: Mark operational boundaries
principles.summary: Record a deliberate capacity limit, its affected workload, a real signal, and the next mechanism.

principles.title: Write for future readers
principles.summary: Make repository artifacts explain their current purpose, decisions, and evidence without the original conversation.
